import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates(keep='first')
    
    # Clean island labels by stripping extra spaces
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Convert body_mass_g to numeric, handling commas and invalid values
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].replace(',', '', regex=True).astype(float)
    
    # Remove rows with negative flipper_length_mm
    df = df[df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 0]
    
    # Remove rows with out-of-range body_mass_g
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    cleaned_df = clean(df)
    avg_body_mass = cleaned_df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
    return avg_body_mass
